attacked_assumption: Contractors need a new planning layer rather than using their existing GIS scripts.
finding: Generic GIS vendors or in-house scripts can reproduce ranking and maps; replacing GIS would fail adoption.
test_to_falsify: Ask 10 project managers to show the last planning/QA workflow and identify a step they would pay to remove.
resolution: Narrow to import/export around existing GIS; no map platform replacement.

attacked_assumption: A prioritized queue materially reduces field or QA work.
finding: All 5,500 properties may still need inspection under contract, so reducing visit count may be impossible.
test_to_falsify: Measure planning, duplicate resolution, revisit and QA time rather than promise fewer mandatory visits.
resolution: Value metric changed from visit reduction to planning/QA/revisit reduction.

finding: A rule-based, explainable delta queue may sell sooner and avoid black-box objections.
test_to_falsify: Manual backtest on one completed project.
resolution: MVP uses deterministic rules and records reasons; ML deferred.

attacked_assumption: Computer vision can judge evidence quality without labels.
finding: Photo angle, local criteria and hidden defects make automated quality judgment unreliable and liable.
test_to_falsify: Start with metadata/required-shot completeness and duplicate/blur flags; compare to human QA.
resolution: No defect classification in MVP; checklist completeness only.

attacked_assumption: Photo QA is a standalone product.
finding: It may be a feature of field survey software.
test_to_falsify: Price a standalone audit service on an existing project package.
resolution: Keep as separate validation candidate, not full build.

attacked_assumption: Municipal output schemas can be standardized.
finding: Each specification may differ enough to create low-margin custom mappings.
test_to_falsify: Collect five real deliverable definitions and measure reusable vs project-specific mapping fields.
resolution: Support only three common templates plus paid mapping; kill if reusable fields <70%.

finding: File conversion and validation report can prove value before an API.
test_to_falsify: Concierge conversion of two sample deliverables.
resolution: MVP is upload/convert/validation report; API later.
